CrawlEngine with defaults scrapes a page identically to the free function

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engine = createEngine(null);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await scrape(engine, url);
  console.log(result.statusCode);
  console.log(result.contentType);
  console.log(result.metadata?.title);
  console.log(result.metadata?.description);
  console.log(result.links?.length);
  console.log(result.metadata?.headings?.length);
}

void main();
```
